fundamentals.fittingMethod: Recency-weighted ridge regression with partially pooled candidate intercepts; separate Senate/governor fits. Candidate residuals reflect opponents and turnout too, not identified personal causal effects.
fundamentals.nationalEnvironment: Current generic ballot margin. Approval shown as context; a hypothetical approval change adjusts the scenario environment only, without counting baseline approval twice.
fundamentals.validationCaveat: Forward-year conditional diagnostics use realized national House popular vote, which was not known in advance.
